messages:
anna_sales: Heads-up: Acme CISO asked for SOC2 excerpt, ISO controls snapshot, signed pen-test attestation, and presigned upload for their POC. They also want confirmation that staging data won't leave EU for the test. Need this by EOD Fri.

tom_pre_sales: Thanks. Can we confirm scope: is Acme asking for a full report or a short controls matrix + bridge letter?

acme_ciso: short controls matrix + a pen-test attestation signed by legal is sufficient for our procurement team. Also confirmation that KMS keys used in the demo are customer-isolated (we understand they won't be for hosted POC but need to note it).

emily_security: We can provide a redacted controls matrix and a pen-test attestation template. Note: our standard pen-test letter says we permit external scans on pre-approved IPs and that we don't provide credentials. If they require credentialed scans, we'll need a legal exception.

oliver_legal: I'll review and sign the attestation. But if the letter contains any statements about incident liability or indemnity we have to tighten language. Please point out any clauses you want preserved.

nisha_ops: For EU data residency: we can stage the POC in the eu-west-1 staging cluster. Ops will set up a temporary S3 bucket in eu-west-1 with presigned PUT links. Need expected file size and retention window.

anna_sales: @acme_ciso they said uploads will be small (control artifacts + pen-test letter), <50MB. Retention requested 14 days. Is eu-west staging ok?

acme_ciso: yes eu-west is fine. 14 days retention ok.

carol_finance: pricing check: if they want Dedicated for throughput tests during the POC (3 days of A10G-like capacity) estimate uplift ~ $2,400 for the short burst. Full 2-week Dedicated trial is higher — let me know exact days.

tom_pre_sales: Action items: (1) Security produce redacted controls matrix + pen-test template, (2) Legal supply signed attestation with limited warranty language, (3) Ops create eu-west presigned bucket with 14d TTL, (4) Finance confirm Dedicated uplift for 3-day burst. Anything missing?

emily_security: Uploading controls matrix now. File: s3://attestations/acme-poc/eu/soc2-controls-redacted-2025.pdf. Pen-test attestation draft: s3://attestations/acme-poc/eu/pen-test-attestation-draft.pdf. Presigned links will be produced by ops.

oliver_legal: I'm redlining the attestation: removing open indemnity and adding maximum liability cap equal to fees paid for the POC. Will return signed PDF after sign-off by L4.
nisha_ops: Presigned PUT links created by s3-bot: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/attestations/acme-poc/eu/soc2-controls-redacted-2025.pdf?presign=abc123 (7d). Archive policy set to auto-delete after 14 days. Staging CIDR for scans: 18.194.32.0/27 reserved Thu-Fri next week.
s3-bot: Audit: presigned links created at 1755992605 by nisha_ops.

carol_finance: Confirming Dedicated uplift quote for 3-day A10G-equivalent burst = $2,350. Sending PO line in email.

anna_sales: Great. Oliver, once you upload the signed attestation I'll send the presigned link to Acme procurement and confirm scan window with ops.

oliver_legal: Uploaded signed_attestation_acme_2025-03-12.pdf to s3 and signed the manifest. s3 path: s3://attestations/acme-poc/eu/signed_attestation_acme_2025-03-12.pdf (presigned link attached in DM).

emily_security: Confirming pen-test scope: external unauthenticated scan only unless Acme explicitly requests credentialed test. Also note we do not provide root access or HSM/KMS exports for POC.

acme_ciso: understood. We'll run an external scan Thu morning and share results. If we need credentialed scans we'll reopen discussion. Thanks team.

anna_sales: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update Acme and capture costs in the POC agreement. Closing the loop.
